subject: Draft MAP and stakeholder ownership — Nimbus Financial
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP and stakeholder ownership — Nimbus Financial

Hi Claire / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion and a clear path. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and dependencies. Please review the ownership column and confirm the RACI for each milestone (economic buyer / security owner / legal owner / eng lead).

High-level proposed timeline (subject to your confirmation):
- Week 1: Security questionnaire + data flow review (owner: Samir)
- Week 2: Technical POC + performance targets (owner: Martin)
- Week 3: Contract terms + pricing sign-off (owner: Claire / Elena)
- Week 4: Go-live prep / onboarding (owner: Nimbus ops + Redwood SE)

Key asks for you:
1) Confirm the four owners above (economic buyer, security, legal, eng lead)
2) Flag any dependencies we missed (e.g., procurement paperwork, internal legal review windows)
3) Call out a target close date that works for your stakeholders

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (MAP draft), security-questionnaire.pdf (our stewarding questionnaire)

If helpful, I can convert the MAP into a shared Drive spreadsheet and maintain weekly status updates. Proposed next step: after you confirm owners, we can lock milestones and schedule a 30-min alignment on Thursday.

Thanks — looking forward to alignment.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(d) +1 415-555-0142

From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@nimbusfin.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patil <samir.patil@nimbusfin.com>, Elena Novak <elena.novak@nimbusfin.com>, Martin Zhao <martin.zhao@nimbusfin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and stakeholder ownership — Nimbus Financial

Thanks, Dylan — appreciate the clear draft. Quick confirmations from our side: we like the milestone breakdown. Ownership for RACI as we currently see it:
- Economic buyer: Claire Bennett (me) — accountable for budget and final approval
- Security owner: Samir Patil — will handle questionnaire and any infra constraints
- Legal owner: Elena Novak — will manage contract redlines and NDAs
- Engineering lead: Martin Zhao — will run the POC and validate performance

Target close: we are aiming for internal sign-off the week starting Aug 30 — so a target close date of 2026-09-03 is realistic if we keep to the milestones. Two dependencies to flag:
- Procurement needs a PO approval window that can add 7–10 business days after contract sign-off
- Our SRE team requires a short architecture diagram before the POC (Samir will request this)

We’ll review the attached MAP in more detail and send any redlines by EOD tomorrow. For now: confirm that Redwood will own the POC environment setup and provide a one-page dataflow diagram for Samir.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@nimbusfin.com>, Samir Patil <samir.patil@nimbusfin.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and stakeholder ownership — Nimbus Financial

Dylan / team,

Thanks Claire — that ownership mapping looks right. A few internal notes and a small adjustment to the MAP I’ll make before we share the Drive version:

1) Redwood owners to call out explicitly in the MAP:
   - AE (owner): Dylan Brooks — commercial lead / contract liaison
   - SE (owner): Marissa Cole — technical POC lead and runbook owner
   - Escalation (owner): Sergio Alvarez — SLAs / Dedicated capacity questions

2) On the POC scope: we’ll scope a 72-hour run with sample queries representative of your peak concurrency; Martin, please confirm the expected qps and sample corpus size in your reply to Samir.

3) Security artifacts: I’ve attached our standard security questionnaire to my internal copy — we should return a completed security-questionnaire.pdf within 5 business days after Samir confirms the architecture request.

4) Procurement: we recommend starting contract term discussions in parallel with the POC to avoid the PO delay Claire mentioned. If legal wants a draft redline, I can coordinate with Elena to accept comments in DocuSign or shared Drive.

I’ll update the MAP with the roles above and convert to a shared Drive spreadsheet (link to follow). Dylan, can you confirm Redwood will provide the one-page dataflow diagram by EOD tomorrow? Sergio — looping you on the SLA / Dedicated gating items.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patil <samir.patil@nimbusfin.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@nimbusfin.com>, Elena Novak <elena.novak@nimbusfin.com>, Martin Zhao <martin.zhao@nimbusfin.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and stakeholder ownership — Nimbus Financial

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming: Samir will be security owner and will circulate architecture requests by tomorrow morning. A few quick items from our side:

- Please send the one-page dataflow diagram and a sample whitelist of IP ranges for the POC.
- We will need confirmation that any customer data used in the POC will be isolated and logged — brief note on retention policy would help.
- Elena will kick off legal intake; we prefer redlines in a Google Doc for faster iteration.

Target close date (confirmed): 2026-09-03 (subject to procurement PO timing).
